engineDefinition.replacementLevels: replacementLevels(pool, rosters): counts empty starting slots per group (dem[g]), then takes the (dem[g]-1)th OVR (0-indexed) from the group-sorted player pool — i.e. the best available player NOT yet needed as a starter, per group.
engineDefinition.staticReplacement: staticReplacement(): all 32 rosters have every slot empty; pool = PLAYERS filtered by POS_SLOT_MAP. Returns one replacement OVR per group.
engineDefinition.winsBase: WINS_BASE = 70. staticWins(p) = sum over STATIC_SLOTS[p.pos] of (slotWins(s, p.ovr) - slotWins(s, 70)).
engineDefinition.staticSlots: STATIC_SLOTS maps each position to the slot(s) whose value counts for that player (e.g. WR -> WR1/WR2/WR3, CB -> CB1/CB2/CB3, DT -> DT1/DT2).
engineDefinition.groups: WV_SLOT_GROUP / WV_TAG_GROUP assign each slot and each position to a group (OL, DL, LB, CB, S, WR, TE, RB, QB, K, P, ...).
engineDefinition.note: Replacement is a LEAGUE-WIDE scarcity concept: as more teams fill a group, the replacement OVR for that group rises (fewer good players left). It is NOT a fixed 70 or a fixed percentile.

known.realUsage: rank5 mean 32.8% snaps (median 35%, p25 22%, p75 44%), 2023-2025, n=1632 team-games
known.sensitivity: weight 91..184 across 22%-44% share (fitlm, other spots refit <=1.8%)
